HD texture pack folder
======================

Drop the replacement artwork here (PNG, JPEG or WebP, named like the original
texture) and the game draws it in OpenGL. The folder ships empty on purpose:
with no artwork the game keeps the original textures, and the launcher can
point this feature at another folder (Mods > Visual > HD Texture Packs).

The R4 pack with the HD HUD (rank, record, lap and time digits, speedometer,
RPM gauge and the course maps) is the player's own file and is not shipped
here.
